approval.notes: Display P3 authoring space (KROMORA_AUTHORING_SPACE: displayP3), sRGB transfer encoding (KROMORA_ENCODING: sRGBTransfer), 33^3 lattice, inputs bounded to 0...1. Parameters are expressed in P3, not converted from sRGB tables; colours outside the P3 gamut are not represented. WorkingSpace.current is Display P3 and Look interpolation uses the cube's stamp (checked against RenderPipeline/CubeLUT). Best-guess approximation of a very high-contrast, crushed-shadow, bright-highlight look with low uniform saturation and almost no hue shift; reviewed by eye on neutral RAW develops only, no fidelity to any camera claimed; no camera profile, reference pair or commercial emulation data used.
approval.reviewer: KRMA-1107 structural verification (SlideLookGeneratorTests, FilmLookStructureTests); no reference to match
